payload.name: Preserve-all-enumerated-hobbies-and-interests
payload.description: When a user explicitly names multiple hobbies, interests, or enjoyed activities in one message, apply during extraction and CRUD to ensure every listed item is stored, not just the first or most elaborated one.
content: During extraction, when a message explicitly enumerates a person's hobbies, interests, or enjoyed activities (e.g., 'X and Y' or 'A, B, and C'), preserve every listed item in memory candidates. Do not drop secondary items because they receive less explanation or emphasis.
If the message elaborates on only one item, still capture the other listed items in the same or separate candidates so the complete preference set is stored.

During CRUD, before accepting an ADD, compare the candidate against the source message; if any explicitly listed hobby/interest item is missing, supplement the candidate or update the existing memory instead of committing an incomplete one.

solves: When extracting memories from a message where a user explicitly lists several hobbies, interests, or enjoyed activities, the constructor may capture only the first or elaborated item and omit the rest, leaving the memory incomplete for later questions. This Skill enforces that all enumerated items in such statements are preserved, avoiding missing preference claims. It applies to any future message with explicit multi-item hobby/interest/enjoyment lists, not to implied or vague statements.
